verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Glama as an MCP directory, hosting and gateway service with a REST API, plus a multi-model chat UI. Nothing documents a way to operate Glama itself, such as searching the registry, deploying servers or setting tool access, through natural-language commands. The chat features (diagrams from text descriptions, document Q&A) are LLM chat functions, not natural-language control of the product, and a user's own AI agent reading the docs is a user-side workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
